Subject: order entry at Larkfield

Hi Gareth,

Noticed Larkfield is hiring two order entry administrators. Keying emailed orders by hand tends to grow with every new customer.

We built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business.

Is this on your radar?

Sam
Nextron AI

If you'd rather not hear from me, reply "stop" and I won't email again. Privacy notice: https://www.example.com/nextron/privacy

Interesting, but we've got a system migration finishing at the end of the month. Drop me a line on 14 December and I'll have more headspace.

Gareth
